question:
Select the option that expresses the meaning of the underlined segment.

The regulation bans any direct or indirect promotion through radio or television of __supernatural__ practices.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Occult"** refers to supernatural, mystical, or magical beliefs, practices, or phenomena. (गूढ़)

 
 
• **Example:** She was fascinated by the **occult **and spent hours studying ancient texts.
 
 
 
• **"Supernatural"** pertains to entities, forces, or phenomena that are beyond the laws of nature and not explainable by science. (अलौकिक)
 
 
• **Example:** Stories of** supernatural **occurrences have been told for centuries.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that **"occult"** is the **correct word **that expresses the meaning of the underlined segment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Questionable** (संदिग्ध): Something that is doubtful or uncertain.

 
 
• **Example:** The authenticity of the document was **questionable.**
 
 
 
• **Obtuse** (मंदबुद्धि): Annoyingly insensitive or slow to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** He was being **obtuse **on purpose to annoy his teacher.
 
 
 
• **Evident** (स्पष्ट): Plain or obvious; clearly seen or understood.
 
 
• **Example:** The benefits of the new policy were **evident** to everyone.
 
 

4e:Tcd1,

The correct answer is Option 2
